title: Schedule
description: The order in which the lessons are taught at the University of Florida

---

This is the order in which the material is taught at the University of Florida,
with the dates from the most recent offering of the course. Self-guided learners
can follow the same sequence.

{{< include _schedule_table.md >}}

Project work days and presentations do not have lesson pages.

To change the schedule, edit [`schedule/schedule.csv`](https://github.com/weecology/forecasting-course/blob/main/schedule/schedule.csv)
and run `python3 scripts/build_schedule.py`.
